svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/decisions_readme.py from decisions/register.yaml. Answers are the lead's words as recorded; the AI decides only decider: claude questions (reversible technical choices).

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety

assessment process on civil aircraft · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EVT-nnn = test or demonstration event

record (safety/events/) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0

none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA
= system hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 205) · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
